cases.requirement: Create a travel-advance request form. Staff enter a destination and planned amount, submit the request, inspect its status, and retry after a simulated submission failure without losing their values.
constraints: Require destination and a positive planned amount

cases.requirement: Create an equipment-loan application. Staff enter an item code and return date, submit an application, review its confirmation, and recover from a simulated unavailable-item response.
constraints: Require item code and return date
Preserve the application when the item is unavailable
Allow a corrected application to be submitted

cases.requirement: Create an archive catalogue. Visitors search document titles, filter by collection, open details of a selected document, and clear an empty search to browse again.
Create a purchase-request review board. A reviewer finds a pending request, opens its details, starts review, and either approves it or returns it for corrections with visible feedback.
constraints: Keep approval and return-for-correction states distinct

cases.requirement: Create a visitor-pass form that requires visitor name and host, submits a pass request, shows confirmation, and allows correction after invalid input.
constraints: Allow invalid input to be corrected

cases.requirement: Create a delivery queue where an operator finds a parcel, opens its details, starts dispatch, and observes dispatch completion or a retryable failure.
constraints: Allow retry after a failed dispatch
